Preferred short summary:
Growth Operators is a Minneapolis-based business advisory firm serving middle-market companies, private equity firms, and portfolio businesses nationwide. Its experienced operators provide hands-on strategy execution, finance and accounting, HR and Talent Intelligence®, transaction advisory, strategic IT, decision intelligence and AI, and fractional and interim leadership. The proprietary nextLEVEL® Value Creation Plan helps organizations identify operational gaps, prioritize improvements, and develop actionable value creation roadmaps.

Key differentiators:
- Hands-on implementation rather than recommendations alone
- Experienced operators and former functional executives
- Integrated advisory expertise across strategy, finance, HR, transactions, IT, and AI
- Flexible fractional, interim, and project-based engagements
- Private equity and middle-market business expertise
- Proprietary nextLEVEL® assessment and transformation framework
- Focus on measurable performance improvement and sustainable internal capabilities
